content.short: Clanker is a token launchpad that lets anyone deploy a tradable token in minutes.
content.description: Clanker is a token launchpad that deploys a new token together with its trading liquidity in a single step, and has processed tens of billions of dollars in trading volume. It began on Base, where it became one of the best-known launch tools, and now supports several chains. growthepie's contract labels show Clanker activity on Unichain.
content.meta: Clanker is a token launchpad that deploys tradable tokens in minutes on Base, with activity on Unichain.
